items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: he came with our band because we were making more money in Morgan

ctx.x: I don't know. Maybe we'll be able to tell you. Was he before Handy or? Before Handy or? I just can't get them together. Let's see. I think he was before Handy. Was it before he was with Sam Morgan or after? No, after he was with Morgan. Oh he made those records with Morgan in 27 I believe it was. So it would have to be after 27 then.
It was after Morgan because he came with our band because we were making more money in Morgan and he was glad to be with us but it was hard to get along with.
What about Albert French? Do you know him, the banjo player? Yeah I know him but he never played any of them. And what about Gilbert Young?
